cellOutsideTable: A cell extends beyond the table.
cellCrossesSections: A cell cannot span table sections.
selectMultipleCells: Hold Shift and click to select at least two cells.
mergeAcrossSections: Cells cannot be merged across table sections.
selectTableCell: Select a cell in the table.
tableNotRectangular: The table must form a complete rectangle.
insertRowCrossesMerge: Cannot insert a row through a vertically merged cell.
rowPositionUnknown: Cannot determine where to insert the row.
insertColumnCrossesMerge: Cannot insert a column through a horizontally merged cell.
columnPositionUnknown: Cannot determine where to insert the column.
deleteAllRows: Cannot delete every row in the table.
deleteRowCrossesMerge: The deletion boundary cannot cross another vertically merged cell.
deleteAllColumns: Cannot delete every column in the table.
deleteColumnCrossesMerge: The deletion boundary cannot cross another horizontally merged cell.
headerFirstRowOnly: Only the first row can be set as the header.
headerVerticalMerge: A row with vertically merged cells cannot be set as the header.
undoInterfaceUnavailable: This version of Typora does not support the undo interface required for table editing.
nativeUndoUnavailable: This version of Typora does not support native undo.
documentChanged: The document has changed or is locked.
deleteTableUnavailable: This version of Typora does not support deleting tables.
tableBlockMissing: Cannot find the table's document block.
emptyParagraphConversionFailed: Cannot convert the table to an empty paragraph.
unsavedTableConflict: The document has changed or is locked. You can still copy unsaved table content; reopen the document and try again.
tableConversionFailed: Cannot convert the input to a single HTML table block.
tablePreviewMissing: Typora did not generate an editable table preview.
tableEditUnavailable: The generated table cannot enter edit mode.
